items.title: [Rowland] Henri Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL.
items.author: Substance59
items.body_excerpt: Henri Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL. Veesaar will undergo surgery with Dr. Kyle Hammond at the Emory Sports Medicine Complex in October and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season. Note: Veesaar’s injury was suffered during a workout on Sept. 15…
